faqs.question: When does enrollment typically begin?
faqs.answer: Basic education enrollment follows DepEd national schedules, usually between June and July. Higher education institutions begin admissions from April through August.

service: Roxas City Tertiary Educational Assistance (Mayor's Scholarship)
description: Financial tuition and stipend support granted to deserving underprivileged college students residing in Roxas City.
steps: Secure application form from the Local Youth Development Office (LYDO) at Roxas City Hall Compound.
Submit certified true copy of grades (GWA 85% or 2.0 with no failing mark).
Undergo socio-economic interview and verification with CSWDO social assessors.
Attend scholarship orientation and claim semester grant payout at the City Treasury Office.
requirements: Certificate of Indigency from Barangay of residence in Roxas City
Official Certificate of Enrollment / Registration from accredited college/university
Certified True Copy of Grades from preceding semester
Voter's Certification of parent/guardian or applicant (Roxas City voter)

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Bona fide college students residing in Roxas City
